# Adaptive Traces captured contract

Derived from accepted D1a reader captures, section 9. Field names, containers, booleans and verified bounded policy types retained; all other strings and numeric tunables replaced with synthetic values. Bodies/actions are test-only shape evidence, never collector output. These are not measurements of the synthetic estate. Pending-state permutations in tests are explicit mutations, not claimed live observations.
